transcript.text:
Good afternoon! I’m calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your overdue credit card payment. I’d like to remind you that a payment is pending on your card, and the total outstanding includes a late fee of ₹1500. Delayed payment can negatively affect your credit score and may lead to legal action.

Could you please let me know when you’ll be able to make this payment? If you’re facing any difficulties, I’m here to help – and we do have some discount options if needed.
Haan haan theek hai. I didn’t quite catch the late fee part, could you say that again?

Of course, thank you for asking. The late fee applied to your credit card account is ₹1500 due to the delayed payment. This amount is added to your outstanding balance.

If you have any difficulty paying the late fee or the total amount, please let me know. We can explore some discount options for you as well.

May I know when you’ll be able to make the payment?
Haan haan theek hai. What do you mean by the minimum due? I'm not sure I understand that part. Could you explain it again?

Absolutely, I’m happy to explain. The minimum due is the smallest amount you need to pay this month to keep your account in good standing and avoid further late fees or penalties. It’s usually a small percentage of your total outstanding balance, plus any interest and fees.

Paying only the minimum due will prevent additional late fees, but the remaining balance will continue to accrue interest at around 12% per year until fully paid. For your best financial health, we recommend paying the full outstanding amount whenever possible.

Would you like to know the exact minimum due on your account today?
Haan haan theek hai. Yes, please tell me the exact minimum due. I want to make sure I pay the right amount.

Thank you for your interest in clearing your dues. Based on your account, your exact minimum due amount is ₹3,800, which includes the overdue amount, interest, and the late fee of ₹1,500.

Paying at least this amount by the due date will prevent further late fees and keep your account in good standing. However, I encourage you to pay more if possible to reduce your interest charges.

Would you be able to make this payment today, or do you need any assistance with the payment process?
Haan haan theek hai. I think I can make the payment on the 15th of this month. Is that alright?
